body:
Implement Wave 2 T-P19 from .adlc/specs/enhancement-resolution-plan.md:

1. model-ratchet:
   - Use lstatSync and skip .worktrees in packages/model-ratchet/lib/walk.mjs.
   - Pass result.stdout (not stderr-polluted combinedOutput) into parseFindingsFromOutput in packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs.
   - Exclude https?:// URL schemes from finding-line matching and location parsing in packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs.
   - Update packages/model-ratchet/test/integration.test.mjs and add packages/model-ratchet/test/walk-and-verdict.test.mjs.

2. review-calibration:
   - Normalize repo-relative paths instead of basename() in packages/review-calibration/lib/scorer.mjs (while preserving bare-filename matching).
   - Add OpenAI o1/o3/o4 model-family prefixes in packages/review-calibration/lib/judge.mjs.

3. @adlc/preflight:
   - Randomize ephemeral branch names (preflight-check-<pid>-<hex>), enforce command timeouts in runCmd, and forward opts.env across checks in packages/preflight/lib/{checks,runner}.mjs.
   - Update packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs.

4. core / rejection-mining / tickets:
   - Use StringDecoder('utf8') for streaming stdout/stderr chunks in packages/core/lib/llm.mjs.
   - Pin --repo in packages/rejection-mining/lib/gh.mjs.
   - Split $EDITOR command + flags via a zero-dependency quote-aware helper inside packages/tickets/lib/edit.mjs.
   - Rebuild Cursor bundles via npm run build:cursor-mcp.

Verification:
npm run build:cursor-mcp && node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/*.test.mjs packages/review-calibration/test/*.test.mjs packages/preflight/test/*.test.mjs packages/rejection-mining/test/*.test.mjs packages/tickets/test/edit.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-store-boundary.test.mjs
title: Wave 2 T-P19 (R7): Fix model-ratchet, review-calibration scorer/judge, @adlc/preflight isolation, and core/ticket/gh utilities
